finalText:
All objectives complete. The console errors were expected: two 401s from the pre-login session check, and one 409 Conflict from my deliberate first attempt at "Mark Ready" that revealed the precondition.

## Final Report

**1. DONE** — Ticket created: ref **RD-1015**, title **"dpm3 RD Bench Ticket"**, customer "Bench User", raised 2026-08-24, initial status Draft.

**2. DONE** — Part **"dpm3 RD Part A"** created with cost $100.00 and markup 25%. App-computed price: **$125.00**.

**3. DONE** — Part **"dpm3 RD Part B"** created with cost $200.00 and markup 25%. App-computed price: **$250.00**. (Ticket total at that point: $375.00.)

**4. DONE** — Part A's cost edited from 100 to **$150.00** (markup still 25%). App-computed price afterwards: **$187.50**. (Ticket total became $437.50.)

**5. DONE** — Ticket ends in status **Ready**. The precondition I discovered and satisfied: **every part on the ticket must have a supplier**. My first "Mark Ready" attempt was rejected with an alert titled "Ticket is not ready" listing:
- `Part "dpm3 RD Part A" has no supplier`
- `Part "dpm3 RD Part B" has no supplier`

I edited both parts to set supplier "Northline Supply" (leaving cost/markup/qty unchanged), after which "Mark Ready" succeeded and the status badge changed from Draft to **Ready** (the button set changed to "Mark Draft" / "Mark Closed" / "Archive ticket").

**6. DONE** — Both parts deleted (each via Delete → confirm dialog "Delete the part … This cannot be undone." → "Delete part"), leaving the parts table showing "No parts on this ticket yet." The ticket was then archived via "Archive ticket"; the detail page now shows "Status: Ready · Archived" with an "Unarchive ticket" button. Verified on the tickets list: with "Show archived" unchecked the list shows 13 tickets and no `dpm3` match; with it checked, RD-1015 appears as "dpm3 RD Bench Ticket Archived", status Ready, **0 parts**. Nothing created by this run remains active.
